title: The Key on the Library Steps
story: After closing, the librarian found a brass key on the front steps. It did not fit the main door or the office. She placed it in a labelled box and wrote the time. The next morning Caleb asked about a key with a green tag. The tag was missing, but the shape matched his drawing. Caleb said he had used it for the music room cupboard. The librarian walked with him to check. The key opened the cupboard at once. Inside, his flute case was safe. Caleb thanked her and tied a new tag on the ring. The librarian added a line to the lost-property book.
